description: Use this when talent, crew, suppliers, or service providers are looking for posted work: gigs, jobs, opportunities, vacancies, slots, bookings, wanted/needed listings, or open calls. Treat those words as search intent—not as genre/type filters. For example, 'DJ gig Amsterdam', 'DJ opportunity in Amsterdam', 'DJ needed listings Amsterdam', and 'I am a DJ looking for work in Amsterdam' all use search_open_calls with portalId='dj' and location='Amsterdam'. Explicit wording such as 'post/find/search open calls' always uses this tool, even when the speaker is a venue manager or private event host. Impersonal posted requirements such as 'analog listening sessions looking for organisers' also use this tool. Do NOT use this as the first choice when a buyer says 'I need/find/want to hire/book a DJ or live band'; call search_availability for that buyer-side intent instead. Venues and event hosts post open calls to find DJs, live bands, comedians, artists, content creators, event crew, solopreneurs, game hosts, casting talent, and more. Returns structured listings with location, genre, type, close date, and a canonical URL. Each result includes allowedResponderRoles so callers can explain who may apply through the listing's canonical web page. All results are PII-free.

format.description: 'markdown' returns paste-ready text. 'json' (default) returns structured data.

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD — only listings closing on or after this date.

genre.description: Optional exact canonical override only; do not guess it from the request. Comma-separated, e.g. 'house,techno'. Values are portal-scoped: genres, art forms, produce categories, liquor styles, and business specialties are matched only inside the relevant vertical. Common spelling and punctuation variants are normalized.

location.description: Place only: suburb/town/city/region/country, e.g. 'St Kilda', 'Amsterdam', 'UK'. Location matching follows the hierarchy: a St Kilda request can include broader Melbourne listings, and a Melbourne request includes listings in child locations.

portalId.description: Optional exact canonical override only. Do not infer or guess this from a role phrase; omit it and let query resolve the vertical. When explicitly supplied, map DJ/disc jockey/deejay to 'dj'; live band/band to 'lb'. Do not put words such as gig, opportunity, needed, wanted, job, or booking here. Supported IDs (omit for all): dj | lb | cc | fs | ec | darts | casting | cue-sports | golf-society | liquor-supply | solopreneur | artist | gh | comedian | demo | poker | bowling | local-produce | coworking | dance-acts

query.description: Pass the user's complete original natural-language request. Prefer query-only rather than guessing portalId, genre, or type, e.g. 'I am a DJ looking for work in Amsterdam' or 'DJ gig Amsterdam'. The server extracts safe portal-scoped role, location, genre/category, and subtype aliases across every active vertical. Examples include 'Texas Holdem poker', 'music bingo game host', and 'analog listening sessions'.

to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD — only listings closing on or before this date.

type.description: Optional exact canonical override only; do not synthesize it from role nouns. Use only a known subtype such as 'open-decks', 'supporting-act', 'music-bingo-night', or the Fourth Spaces session 'analogue-listening'. Never pass generic intent words such as event, session, gig, opportunity, needed, job, booking, or open call.

name: search_open_calls
